crossRefs.note: Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?
My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!
Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.
Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness.
Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth.
I am afflicted very much. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your word.
Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my…
Yahweh, I have heard of your fame. I stand in awe of your deeds, Yahweh. Renew your work in the middle of the years. In…
But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,
even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—
Hear my prayer, Yahweh. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.
But Yahweh reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.
He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.
In you, Yahweh, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.
Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.
The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.
Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but Yahweh delivers him out of them all.
But the salvation of the righteous is from Yahweh. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
Yahweh helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in…
He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.
I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”

translations.web: Revive me, Yahweh, for your name’s sake. In your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.
translations.bsb: For the sake of Your name, O LORD, revive me. In Your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.
translations.kjv: Quicken me, O LORD, for thy name's sake: for thy righteousness' sake bring my soul out of trouble.
translations.asv: Quicken me, O Jehovah, for thy name's sake: In thy righteousness bring my soul out of trouble.
